source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nutritional importance of carbohydrates (PDF 163-164).

blocks.text: Carbohydrates insani sehat mein pecheeda kirdar ada karte hain. Yeh tawanai aur ghizaiyat ke liye zaroori hain, lekin khaye jane wale carbohydrates ki qism aur miqdar sehat par gehra asar dalti hai; durust carbohydrates aur mutawazan miqdar bimari ka khatra kam karti hai.

items: Glucose jaisi saada shakar cells ki tawanai ka asal zariya hai: yeh aasani se jazb aur metabolise hoti hai, 1 g glucose taqreeban 15.6 kJ deta hai. Zaid glucose jigar aur muscles mein glycogen ki shakal mein jama hota hai, isi liye jaanwar aur insaan musalsal muscle ki harkat ke liye glycogen ke zakheere rakhte hain.

Khoon mein aam glucose taqreeban 70-110 mg/dL hota hai, din bhar mein thora badalta, aur insulin aur glucagon hormones se qabu hota hai. Agar khoon ka glucose aam had se barh jaye to diabetes ho sakta hai, aik purani bimari jis mein pancreas kaafi insulin nahi banata ya jism use durust use nahi kar pata. Be-qabu diabetes hyperglycaemia (khoon mein zyada shakar) karta hai, jo waqt ke saath asaab aur khoon ki nalon ko nuqsan de sakta hai. Bohat kam carbohydrate thakan aur kam jismani aur zehni karkardagi ka sabab ban sakta hai.

Fructose metabolism mein tawanai deta hai, lekin zyada miqdar motapa (jism mein zaid charbi) karti hai. Saaf ki gayi shakar wali ghiza diabetes, dil ki bimari aur kuch cancers ke zyada khatre se juri hai, jab ke pecheeda carbohydrates aur resha sehat ki hifazat karte hain.
Jab jism ke paas tawanai ke liye kaafi carbohydrate ho to woh eendhan ke liye proteins ya charbi torne ki bajaye isi ko use karta hai.

blocks.title: Insulin
blocks.text: Insulin pancreas mein banne wala protein hormone hai. Is ki kami, ya jism ka ise use na kar pana, diabetes mellitus ka sabab banta hai (topic 27.2.2).

blocks.prompt: Jism mein zaid glucose ka kya hota hai, aur kaun se hormones khoon ka glucose qabu karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh jigar aur muscles mein glycogen ban kar jama hota hai; insulin aur glucagon khoon ke glucose ki satah qabu karte hain.

items: Glucose: cells ka asal eendhan (taqreeban 15.6 kJ fi g); zaid glycogen ban kar jama.
Khoon ka glucose 70-110 mg/dL, insulin aur glucagon se qabu; zyada: diabetes.
Saaf shakar bimari ka khatra barhati; pecheeda carbohydrates aur resha hifazat karte.
